messages:
anna_revops: Noticing duplicate invoice drafts in NetSuite for several Stripe charge.succeeded events this morning. Looks like some customers got two draft invoices for the same charge id.

lucy_billing: ugh. which accounts? any live invoices created or just drafts?

anna_revops: mostly drafts. sample: acct-778 (inv_draft 20260330-778-1 and 20260330-778-2), acct-900, acct-1022. Estimated duplicates ~8 drafts.

stripe-webhook-bot: stripe-webhook-bot: webhook delivered: /integrations/stripe/events 2026-03-30T09:12:04Z id=evt_3Kz... status=200

peter_infra: quick check: our webhook handler acknowledges and then enqueues a reconcile job. I see retry logs from 09:12:04 and 09:12:04.000 (duplicate delivery idempotency key missing). Looks like the gateway replayed the same payload twice within ms and our reconciler didn't dedupe by stripe event id.

lucy_billing: why didn't NetSuite match the external_ref (stripe_charge_id)? we rely on external_ref to avoid dup drafts.

tom_support: the NS integration maps externalRef to memo field, but the draft creation path accepts duplicates if externalRef is null or longer than 100 chars. Stripe charge IDs are 30+ chars sometimes; maybe truncated.

anna_revops: good catch. sample charge id: ch_3Kz4a9g6N8qQ9XxYzabc12345 (len 32). Our transform truncates memo to 30 chars. That would make two different events appear identical or empty?

peter_infra: root cause: webhook retries + transform truncating external_ref to 30 chars before sending to NS. If truncation causes collision or overflow, NS client returns success and creates a separate draft.

lucy_billing: actionable: 1) we need immediate dedupe: scan drafts created between 09:10-09:20 for duplicate charge prefixes and mark extras to cancel. 2) patch transform to send full charge id (no truncation) and include stripe_event_id in a separate custom field. 3) add idempotency by stripe event id at the reconcile/enqueue layer.

anna_revops: can we run the cancel script for duplicates now? Legal/comms want a note before reaching out if customers affected.

tom_support: I can run a safe script that lists duplicates and shows invoice delta. will not cancel until we ack. dry-run first.

anna_revops: please do dry-run and paste results.

tom_support: dry-run output:
- acct-778: drafts: 2, combined_amount $1,230.00, potential duplicate amount $615.00
- acct-900: drafts: 2, combined_amount $2,400.00, potential duplicate amount $2,400.00 (both drafts unpaid)
- acct-1022: drafts: 2, combined_amount $320.00, potential duplicate $320.00
Total potential duplicates $3,335.00 across 8 drafts.

lucy_billing: ok looks manageable. Approve cancellation of duplicate drafts where charge id matches after full-charge comparison. I'll prepare notes and create a bill correction entry for records.

peter_infra: follow-ups: 1) remove truncation in stripe->ns transform (PR opened) 2) add idempotency key in enqueue using stripe_event_id (hotfix) 3) update webhook consumer to reject/ignore exact-duplicate event ids 4) add end-to-end test for long charge ids.

anna_revops: assigning owners: Peter for infra fixes, Lucy for reconciliation entries and customer notes, Tom for the cancellation dry-run -> final. ETA for hotfix?

peter_infra: hotfix will be deployed in 45m, backfill dedupe script to run for last 24h after deploy.

anna_revops: thanks everyone. please post a short summary in #billing and tag legal if any live invoices got posted.
